facts.fact: The Ministry of Health and Wellness's Health Sector Strategic Plan 2020-2024 gives the share of health facilities using EMR as 0 at its 2019 baseline, against a 2024 target of 100%, with the e-health report as data source; for Rodrigues it gives the E-Health Project at Queen Elizabeth Hospital and the two area health centres as 0 implemented in 2019.

The Ministry of Health and Wellness's Health Sector Strategic Plan 2020-2024 states a 2019 baseline of 0 for the percentage of health facilities using EMR, target 100% by 2024; the figure is a share of all health facilities, with no numerator or denominator, and the plan's Rodrigues chapter lists extension of the E-Health Project to community health centres as an action still to come.

The Health Sector Strategic Plan 2020-2024 is the Ministry of Health and Wellness's own plan and lists implementation of the E-Health Project among the ministry's proposed actions under Strategic Goal 18, with the Rodrigues Commission for Health to implement it at Queen Elizabeth Hospital and the two area health centres; the plan's published date is used.

The Health Sector Strategic Plan 2020-2024 names implementation of the E-Health Project as a proposed action under Strategic Goal 18 and sets a monitoring indicator of 100% of health facilities using EMR by 2024; the plan's published date is used.

The Health Sector Strategic Plan 2020-2024's programme-based budget gives recurrent estimates for the priority Health Information System and Health Research of 1,593,801 over 2020-2024 for Mauritius and 55,347 for Rodrigues, units not shown in the passages, without naming the E-Health Project or a source of funds; Rodrigues's E-Health indicator cites the Budget Estimates as its data source.

The Health Sector Strategic Plan 2020-2024 states that the health information system in Rodrigues is largely manual and very often non-retrievable and non-transferable, with limited analysis of routine data; this is Rodrigues only, undated in the plan's situational analysis, so the plan's published date is used.

note: Passages only, of a 43,039-word plan: the strategic actions of section 7.13 and the list of HIS challenges at 3.1.2.53 are cut off in the passages, so the plan may state more than is recorded here. The class of the Rodrigues HIS fact is a reading the parent should check: the plan describes a general health information system, not specifically routine facility reporting. The plan also gives 20% of private health facilities reporting data in 2019 and no quarterly report reaching the five health regions, neither tied to a digital system. DHIS2 appears only for disease surveillance, so it gives no HMIS fact.
